description:
The user's recent backtest runs, newest first, optionally just the ones for one strategy. Use it when they ask what they have run, or refer to an earlier result without giving an id -- then fetch the one you need with get_backtest. It is how you avoid re-running something that already has an answer. Results are newest first; pass strategy_id to see only one strategy's runs.

[Access: pay 0.001 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]
name: list_backtests
